title: Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes
synopsis: Yoshitaka Murayama’s spiritual successor to Suikoden — retained as 505 Games’ Nintendo Switch game card.

catalog.mediumForm: Nintendo Switch game card · retail edition

custody.physical: Nintendo Switch game card in retail case

curatorNotes:
Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes is the JRPG Suikoden creator Yoshitaka Murayama made with series veterans at Rabbit & Bear Studios: more than a hundred recruitable characters, a headquarters that grows into a town, and six-member turn-based battles. Its 2020 Kickstarter was the year’s most funded video game campaign.

505 Games released it worldwide on April 23, 2024. Murayama died that February, before its release.

The filing joins Eiyuden Chronicle: Rising in the Eiyuden Chronicle lineage.
collectionNotes:
The retained object is 505 Games’ retail edition of Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes on a Nintendo Switch game card.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Nintendo Switch; compatible Nintendo Switch family hardware
preservation.compatibility: Nintendo Switch software is region-free. The retained game card is the primary access copy and runs on any Nintendo Switch console.
preservation.concerns: Game cards are flash media; long-term charge retention, contact wear, and loss of the small card from its case are the principal risks. A day-one update is needed for the intended release state, and the season pass story expansions are eShop downloads; neither is preserved by the card alone.
preservation.knownRevisions: Released worldwide on April 23, 2024 (HAC-P-A9RLA). A day-one patch and a three-part paid story expansion followed.
preservation.availability: Distributed at retail by 505 Games, with a digital edition on the Nintendo eShop.
